description: This file defines a class 'TestDefaultConfiguration' in the 'TestExtensions' namespace, which manages default configuration settings for testing Azure and Orleans-related services. It includes methods to build and initialize configuration, access various configuration values, and handle environment-specific configurations.

classes.name: SerializablePhysicalFileProvider
classes.description: A wrapper around PhysicalFileProvider that allows serialization with JSON by implementing IFileProvider and marking the internal PhysicalFileProvider as NonSerialized.

methods.name: BuildDefaultConfiguration
methods.description: Constructs the default configuration by initializing a ConfigurationBuilder, configuring host settings, and building the configuration object.

methods.name: ConfigureHostConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the IConfigurationBuilder with in-memory collection, JSON files (from environment variable or ancestor folders), and environment variables.

methods.name: TryAddJsonFileInAncestorFolder
methods.description: Searches parent directories for a specific JSON configuration file and adds it to the configuration builder if found.

methods.name: TryAddJsonFileFromEnvironmentVariable
methods.description: Attempts to add a JSON configuration file specified by an environment variable to the configuration builder.
